title: Among users who earned a badge in 2013 and have posted content tagged with
question: Among users who earned a badge in 2013 and have posted content tagged with 'humor', identify the one whose posts have the highest average view count. Return their display name, the number of such humor-tagged posts they authored, and that average view count—but only consider users who have at least two humor-tagged posts and whose total favorite count across those posts is at least 10.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS humor_post_count, AVG(p.XCL_030) AS avg_view_count
FROM users u
INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
INNER JOIN tags t ON p.XCL_026 = t.XCL_050
WHERE b.XCL_004 >= '2013-01-01' AND b.XCL_004 < '2014-01-01' AND t.XCL_048 = 'humor'
GROUP BY u.XCL_052
HAVING COUNT(p.XCL_026) >= 2 AND SUM(p.XCL_039) >= 10
ORDER BY AVG(p.XCL_030) DESC
LIMIT 1

eligibility_lowering.pre_lowering_sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS humor_post_count, AVG(p.XCL_030) AS avg_view_count
FROM users u
INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
INNER JOIN tags t ON p.XCL_026 = t.XCL_050
WHERE b.XCL_004 >= '2013-01-01' AND b.XCL_004 < '2014-01-01' AND t.XCL_048 = 'humor'
GROUP BY u.XCL_052
HAVING COUNT(p.XCL_026) >= 2 AND SUM(p.XCL_039) >= 10
ORDER BY AVG(p.XCL_030) DESC
LIMIT 1
